lines.say: An organelle is a structure in the cell that does a particular job.
Dividing the cell into membrane-bound sections is called compartmentalisation.
It keeps harmful enzymes locked away, like bleach in the laundry cupboard.

draw.alt: A lysosome keeps acidic digestive enzymes inside its membrane, apart from the cytosol

lines.say: It also packs enzymes for one job together, so reactions run faster.
Prokaryotes have no membrane-bound organelles.
The nucleus holds the DNA, inside a double membrane called the nuclear envelope.
Nuclear pores let messenger RNA out. The nucleolus makes ribosome parts.
Ribosomes make proteins. They have no membrane.
Rough ER is studded with ribosomes. It folds proteins for export.
Smooth ER has no ribosomes. It makes lipids and breaks down toxins.
The Golgi receives vesicles from the ER, then modifies, sorts and packages proteins.
Lysosomes hold digestive enzymes. They break down worn-out organelles and bacteria.
Plant cells have a large central vacuole full of cell sap. It keeps the cell firm.
Mitochondria are where most cellular respiration happens.

draw.alt: Mitochondrion with folded inner membrane, the cristae, highlighted

lines.say: The inner membrane folds into cristae, giving a large surface for enzymes.
They don't make energy. They release it from glucose and store it in ATP.
Chloroplasts do photosynthesis. Thylakoids hold the green pigment chlorophyll.
Nucleus, mitochondria and chloroplasts all have double membranes. The last two have their own DNA.
The cytoskeleton is a network of protein fibres. It gives shape and acts as tracks.
It also pulls chromosomes apart when the cell divides.
The cell wall is outside the membrane. In plants it's made of cellulose.
The wall is freely permeable. The membrane is the bouncer that decides.

lines.say: The gene is copied into messenger RNA, which leaves through a nuclear pore.
Ribosomes on the rough ER make the protein. It's folded inside the ER.

lines.say: A vesicle carries it to the Golgi, which modifies and packages it.
A secretory vesicle fuses with the plasma membrane and releases the protein.

draw.alt: Vesicle fuses with the plasma membrane and releases protein outside

lines.say: Pancreas cells exporting enzymes are packed with rough ER and Golgi.
Rough ER makes proteins. Smooth ER makes lipids.
Plant cells have chloroplasts and mitochondria. They respire too.
The cell wall is freely permeable. The membrane controls entry.
Nucleus, rough ER, vesicle, Golgi, vesicle, plasma membrane.
